agendas.name: Sublime Agonies
agendas.description: On Empower with a Pain token, spend 1 extra and place it on the unit's card. Post-game: select up to 6 DRUKHARI units with tokens; each gains 1XP per token (max 3XP). If the Ascendant Lord gained 2+ XP from this agenda, +1 to your next territory D6 roll.

agendas.name: Demonstrate Superiority
agendas.description: Post-game the Ascendant Lord gains 1XP for each condition satisfied: Beasts of the Arena (destroyed a Monster/Vehicle); Trophy-hunter (destroyed a Character); Deadly Reaver (destroyed 3+ units); Send a Message (destroyed enemy Warlord); Power Monger (Empowered 3+ times). If the Ascendant Lord gained 3+ XP, select your next territory instead of rolling.

agendas.name: To Feed the Dark City
agendas.description: Each time a DRUKHARI unit destroys an enemy unit in melee, it gains 1XP (2XP if the destroyed unit was a Character or Monster). Max 4XP per unit. If the Ascendant Lord gained 3+ XP from this agenda, you may re-roll your Rival Activity test.

agendas.name: Fear's Cold Grip
agendas.description: Each time an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test, select one DRUKHARI unit within 12" to gain 2XP. Each time a DRUKHARI unit destroys a Battle-shocked enemy unit, that unit gains 2XP. Max 4XP per unit.

agendas.name: Herd the Prey
agendas.description: Post-game select 3 DRUKHARI units on the battlefield to form a triangle. If 1+ enemy units are wholly within the triangle, each selected unit gains 2XP. If 2+ enemy units are within, each gains 3XP instead and you gain 1RP.
